def _has_chinese_char(text: str) -> bool:
    """判断给定字符串中是否包含至少一个中文字符。"""
    # 检查 Unicode 基本汉字区 \u4e00~\u9fff
    return any("\u4e00" <= ch <= "\u9fff" for ch in (text or ""))


def check_python_s04_gate(py_files: List[pathlib.Path]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    """检查目标 Python 脚本是否满足函数 <=50 行、入参 <=4 个、中文 docstring 及函数体内中文 # 注释门禁 (S04)。"""
    errors: List[str] = []
    # 遍历全部目标脚本，使用 AST 精确校验每个函数的起止行号、入参个数、docstring 与行内 # 注释
    for path in py_files:
        if not path.exists():
            errors.append(f"Missing file for S04 check: {path}")
            continue
        src_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        src_lines = src_text.splitlines()
        tree = ast.parse(src_text, filename=str(path))
        if not _has_chinese_char(ast.get_docstring(tree) or ""):
            errors.append(f"{path.name}: module docstring missing Chinese description")
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                continue
            end_lineno = getattr(node, "end_lineno", node.lineno)
            func_lines = end_lineno - node.lineno + 1
            args_list = list(node.args.posonlyargs) + list(node.args.args) + list(node.args.kwonlyargs)
            if args_list and args_list[0].arg in ("self", "cls"):
                args_list = args_list[1:]
            if func_lines > 50:
                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} lines={func_lines} > 50")
            if len(args_list) > 4:
                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} params={len(args_list)} > 4")
            if not _has_chinese_char(ast.get_docstring(node) or ""):
                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} docstring missing Chinese description")
            body_slice = src_lines[node.lineno - 1 : end_lineno]
            has_cn_hash = any("#" in ln and _has_chinese_char(ln.split("#", 1)[1]) for ln in body_slice)
            if not has_cn_hash:
                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} missing inline Chinese '#' comment in function body")
    return len(errors) == 0, errors
